title: Experience, Strategy and Transformation Terms

header.html: Define the basic terms of ITIL Experience (experience, digital experience, trust, user experience, customer experience, experience level agreement, human-centered design), of ITIL Strategy (strategy, business strategy, digital strategy, mission, vision, purpose, VUCA, leadership) and of ITIL Transformation (change, transformation, business as usual)
the official ITIL Foundation (Version 5) syllabus, version 5.0 (February 2026), category 1.2

html:
1Experience terms

Term Meaning
Experience How a person perceives and feels about interactions over time
Digital experience The experience of interacting through digital channels and products
Trust Confidence that a provider or product will behave as promised
User experience (UX) The experience of a user while using a product or service
Customer experience (CX) The whole experience of a customer with the organization, from first contact on
Experience level agreement (XLA) An agreement on the experience people should have, measured by how they feel, alongside service levels
Human-centered design Designing around people's needs and behavior, testing with them, and improving
Exam tip

. UX = the person using it. CX = the person buying and relating to the organization. XLA = experience target; SLA = performance target.

2Strategy terms

Term Meaning
Strategy The plan for how an organization will achieve its objectives
Business strategy The strategy of the whole organization (where to compete, how to win)
Digital strategy How the organization will use digital technology to achieve its business strategy
Mission What the organization does and for whom (today)
Vision The future the organization wants to reach
Purpose Why the organization exists
VUCA An environment that is Volatile, Uncertain, Complex and Ambiguous
Leadership Guiding and inspiring people toward a shared direction

Exam tip

. Purpose = why. Vision = where we want to be. Mission = what we do. Strategy = how we will get there. VUCA is the setting, not a plan.

3Transformation terms

Term Meaning
Change The addition, modification or removal of anything that could affect products or services
Transformation A major, fundamental shift in how an organization works or creates value
Business as usual (BAU) The normal, day-to-day running of the organization

A transformation often needs many changes; once it lands, the new way becomes BAU.

Exam tip

. When a question gives a short definition, match the keyword: "future" is vision, "why" is purpose, "feel" is experience, "normal running" is BAU.

4Exam Q&A

4.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1Which term describes an environment that is volatile, uncertain, complex and ambiguous?

  • ABAU
  • BVUCA
  • CXLA
  • DCX
Show the answer

Answer: B. VUCA stands for volatile, uncertain, complex and ambiguous.

S2A retailer measures how happy shoppers feel after a support chat and agrees a target for it. Which concept is this?

  • AA service level agreement only
  • BAn experience level agreement
  • CA value stream map
  • DA known error record
Show the answer

Answer: B. An XLA sets targets for the experience, measured by how people feel.

S3Which statement is CORRECT? (1) Vision is the future the organization wants to reach. (2) Purpose is why the organization exists. (3) Mission is the plan to reach the vision. (4) Strategy is the day-to-day running of the organization.

  • A3 and 4
  • B1 and 4
  • C1 and 2
  • D2 and 3
Show the answer

Answer: C. Vision is the future and purpose is why it exists.

S4Identify the missing word(s). [ ? ] is the normal, day-to-day operation of an organization.

  • ATransformation
  • BHuman-centered design
  • CBusiness as usual
  • DDigital strategy
Show the answer

Answer: C. That is business as usual.

S5A team studies how users behave, builds prototypes with them, and revises the design. Which concept does this describe?

  • AHuman-centered design
  • BBusiness strategy
  • CA service request
  • DAccess to resources
Show the answer

Answer: A. Human-centered design builds around people's needs and tests with them.

S6Which term covers how an organization will use digital technology to reach its business goals?

  • ADigital experience
  • BDigital strategy
  • CTrust
  • DLeadership
Show the answer

Answer: B. A digital strategy links technology to the business strategy.

4.2 Recall questions

R1What does XLA stand for?

Show the answer

Experience level agreement.

R2What does VUCA stand for?

Show the answer

Volatile, uncertain, complex and ambiguous.

R3What is the difference between UX and CX?

Show the answer

UX is a user's experience of using something; CX is a customer's whole experience with the organization.

R4Purpose answers which question?

Show the answer

Why does the organization exist?

R5What is change?

Show the answer

The addition, modification or removal of anything that could affect products or services.

R6What is transformation?

Show the answer

A major shift in how an organization works or creates value.

5Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Experience UX (user), CX (customer), XLA (experience target), trust, human-centered design
Direction purpose = why, vision = where, mission = what, strategy = how
VUCA volatile, uncertain, complex, ambiguous
Change add, modify or remove something that could affect products or services
Transformation / BAU major shift / normal running
